title: Advanced prompt injection
interaction: beginner (7 guided typed commands) or expert (real shell + nano)

models.shared_note: SHARED with labs 4, 5, 6 and 7 - the whole model tier. Any lab needing an instruction-following model MUST reuse this exact ID, file and path. Verified 2026-09-14: lab 3's model layer is now digest sha256:8e259fa11b94..., 1,092,414,416 bytes, byte-identical to the layer labs 4-7 already publish.

measured.injection_reliability: 3/3 on two payload styles, verified after quantisation

rejected_alternatives.google/flan-t5-small: 0/4 payload styles - cannot follow injected commands
rejected_alternatives.Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct: 1/3 - unusable, and failures produced confused output
rejected_alternatives.Qwen2.5-1.5B bf16: 3/3 but 9.0 GB RAM and 21.7s/answer at 2 cores

python_packages.name: llama-cpp-python
python_packages.note: From the prebuilt wheel in Activity-Labs/wheels via a named build context. Never compiled in a lab. Lab 3 compiled it in a multi-stage build until 2026-09-14; a compiled layer can never be shared because the compiler is not deterministic, and the build stage also shipped an unpinned second numpy.

python_packages.name: numpy
python_packages.note: Not imported by lab 3. Present because requirements.txt is a verbatim copy of the shared file.

python_packages.name: pillow
python_packages.note: Not imported by lab 3. The price of the shared layer, and the right trade.

apt_packages.name: libgomp1
apt_packages.note: REQUIRED. libllama.so links against OpenMP; without it the import dies with 'libgomp.so.1: cannot open shared object file'.

apt_packages.name: curl
apt_packages.note: Students fetch the page the way the assistant does.

apt_packages.name: ca-certificates
apt_packages.note: Part of the byte-identical apt line shared by labs 3-8. Do not remove it to tidy up.

not_used.name: torch
not_used.reason: llama.cpp runs the model. Lab 3 needs no PyTorch at all.

network: None at run time. Mock site served from inside the container on 127.0.0.1 only. /etc/hosts maps news.acme.com to 127.0.0.1 so the URL looks real.

measured.note: Re-measured 2026-09-14 on the live registry after the realignment, arm64, Docker 29.7.2, buildx v0.36.1 / buildkit v0.32.2. Download is what a student pays who already has labs 1-2 - per-lab-in-isolation numbers hide the sharing.
measured.determinism: 4/4 consecutive runs hijacked at temperature 0, identical output, after the wheel switch
